title: Could a 1Password server breach expose my vault
issue: Could a 1Password server breach expose my vault
resolution_html:
A compromise of 1Password's servers would not automatically expose the readable contents of every vault. 1Password uses end-to-end encryption and keeps decryption secrets under the account holder's control. No service can guarantee that all threats are impossible

Read 1Password's current explanation of its encryption and authentication model

title: How 1Password protects your vault
issue: How 1Password protects your vault
resolution_html:
1Password encrypts vault data on the user's device before synchronization, so its service does not normally hold the secrets needed to decrypt that data. Your account password and Secret Key remain important protections
